headline: Dallas Baptist, St. Mary's and Sul Ross State still goalless
dek: The three have lost all five of the matches they have played between them and conceded fifteen goals, ten of them Sul Ross State's. The other eight programmes have scored 34 goals and been beaten twice.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Seven different players have scored Midwestern State's eleven goals, and Jose Ortiz has four of them.

wire.line: Oklahoma Christian have won both their matches and have not conceded a goal.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: All three of the season's silent finals are Lubbock Christian's: each match is marked final and carries no published score. Two more matches are past their date with no result at all — a separate absence, and a separate count.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: One match with a published score has no box score behind it: Sul Ross State's, at home to CSU Pueblo. That is not a silent final — a silent final has no result whose detail could be missing — and the counts never share a match.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Texas A&M scored all four of their goals in one match and conceded all seven in the other.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Tyler have played once and won it without conceding, and Dennis Nyame's goal is the only one the programme has scored.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Kaleo Perez-Francis has made six saves for St. Edward's and been beaten once.

last_match.line: Texas A&M International have still to lose, and have still to play at home.

next_match.line: Colorado Christian have already been beaten by a Lone Star side this season; West Texas A&M have not yet played away from home.

table_state.statement: The table stays empty until conference play opens on Sep 23: no programme has played a conference match yet, and the form shown beside each row comes from matches played before it opens.
table_state.footnote: A pre-conference table is a valid state, not a missing one.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
